ebooks.seriesHeadlineLine1: From the first conversation with AI
ebooks.seriesText: A practical, progressive series that follows the small-business owner's evolution in using artificial intelligence: first learning how to use the technology, then incorporating it into processes, using information to improve management, and finally applying all of that knowledge to building a business from scratch.

ia-pequenos-negocios.title: Small Businesses with AI
ia-pequenos-negocios.subtitle: The Complete System to Sell, Serve, and Work Better
ia-pequenos-negocios.lead: The first volume introduces artificial intelligence in a practical, accessible way for small-business owners. The goal is to show how AI tools can be used day to day to improve sales, customer service, communication, productivity, and organization.
body: The reader learns to talk more effectively with AI tools, write better prompts, produce content, structure messages, improve customer service, organize tasks, and use the technology as support in real business work.
ia-pequenos-negocios.highlight: The starting point of the series.
ia-pequenos-negocios.question: How can I use AI in my small business?
ia-pequenos-negocios.result: By the end of the volume, the reader will have learned to use artificial intelligence in a practical and deliberate way across everyday business situations.
ia-pequenos-negocios.coverAlt: Cover of the book Small Businesses with AI

transforme-seu-pequeno-negocio-com-ia.title: Transform Your Small Business with AI
transforme-seu-pequeno-negocio-com-ia.subtitle: Automate Processes, Reduce Repetitive Tasks, and Gain Efficiency
transforme-seu-pequeno-negocio-com-ia.lead: After learning how to use artificial intelligence in the first volume, the reader begins to observe how work actually happens inside the business.
body: This book teaches how to distinguish tasks, processes, and automations; identify repetitive activities; map routines; find bottlenecks; create procedures; and organize work more efficiently.

The reader also learns the logic behind automations — triggers, conditions, and actions — and how to apply that in customer service, sales, follow-up, administrative work, forms, spreadsheets, documents, proposals, quotes, and notifications.
AI becomes part of the workflows themselves, instead of being used only in isolation when a need appears.
transforme-seu-pequeno-negocio-com-ia.highlight: From using AI to automating the work.
transforme-seu-pequeno-negocio-com-ia.question: How can I turn my tasks into better, automated processes?
transforme-seu-pequeno-negocio-com-ia.result: The reader stops using AI only occasionally and starts incorporating it into the everyday processes of the business.
transforme-seu-pequeno-negocio-com-ia.coverAlt: Cover of the book Transform Your Small Business with AI

gerencie-seu-pequeno-negocio-com-ia.title: Manage Your Small Business with AI
gerencie-seu-pequeno-negocio-com-ia.subtitle: Use Data, Indicators, and AI to Make Better Decisions
gerencie-seu-pequeno-negocio-com-ia.lead: After learning to use AI and organize processes, the reader moves to a new level: using technology to understand the business itself.
body: This volume teaches how to organize information about sales, revenue, costs, expenses, customers, products, and services, and turn it into useful management insight.
The reader learns to track indicators, compare periods, spot trends, analyze results, and use artificial intelligence to ask questions of their own data.
examples: Which products had a drop in sales?
Which product generates the most revenue?
Is there a pattern among customers who stopped buying?
gerencie-seu-pequeno-negocio-com-ia.highlight: AI analyzes and helps. The entrepreneur decides.
gerencie-seu-pequeno-negocio-com-ia.question: How can I better understand what is happening in my business and make better decisions?
gerencie-seu-pequeno-negocio-com-ia.result: The reader starts using information, indicators, and analysis to support more grounded decisions.
gerencie-seu-pequeno-negocio-com-ia.coverAlt: Cover of the book Manage Your Small Business with AI

crie-seu-pequeno-negocio-com-ia.title: Create Your Small Business with AI
crie-seu-pequeno-negocio-com-ia.subtitle: From Idea to Operation: Build Your Business with AI Support
crie-seu-pequeno-negocio-com-ia.lead: The final volume brings the whole series together in a guided project.
body: The reader starts with an idea — or even without a defined idea — and uses artificial intelligence to research opportunities, understand market problems, define customers, analyze competitors, validate proposals, and structure a small business.
This is not just a book about entrepreneurship. It is a guided project.

The reader does not only learn about target audience: they define the audience of their own business. They do not only read about pricing: they start structuring their own prices. They do not only learn about processes: they design the processes of the new business. They do not only learn about promotion: they prepare their own launch strategy.
crie-seu-pequeno-negocio-com-ia.question: How do I apply all of this to build a small business from scratch?
crie-seu-pequeno-negocio-com-ia.result: The reader applies the knowledge built across the previous three volumes to plan, structure, and prepare a small business to start operating with the support of artificial intelligence.
crie-seu-pequeno-negocio-com-ia.coverAlt: Cover of the book Create Your Small Business with AI

page.seoDescription: Discover Hefesto, a platform built to optimize 190/193 emergency response and incident creation through software, automation, and integration.
page.summary: A platform built to optimize the initial cycle of 190/193 emergency response, structuring information, automating steps, and integrating resources to make incident creation faster and more efficient.

problem.label: THE PROBLEM
problem.p1: The initial handling of an emergency requires several pieces of information to be understood, organized, and recorded before the operational flow can continue.
problem.p2: In a high-volume environment, manual entry and repetitive tasks increased the time needed to turn a call into a structured incident.

solution.label: THE SOLUTION
solution.p1: Hefesto organizes the initial incident cycle into a single operational experience, using structured workflows, automation, lookups, and integrations to support the operator while the record is being built.
solution.p2: The solution brings together location, call information, structured narrative generation, and supporting resources to reduce repetitive steps and increase the consistency of the information.

flow.ariaLabel: Hefesto flow: call, location, collection, narrative, and incident

result.text: Reducing incident creation time in a high-volume operation represents a significant operational gain and allows the operator to focus more attention on the call itself.
